station_name: Bucks Lake near Bucks Lodge, Calif.
township_range_section: NW¼ sec.33, T.24 N., R.7 E.
notes: Extremes table (maximum and minimum contents and elevation) for water years 1961-65: 5 years x 4 values = 20. Dates are the earliest and latest printed extreme dates (Jan. 27, 1961; June 7, 1965); as water years the span would be 1960-10 to 1965-09. Location text also says: in intake tower No. 2 upstream from dam on Bucks Creek, 2 miles northwest of Bucks Lodge and 15 miles west of Quincy. No county printed.
